description: This is a Java interface defining methods for reading or retrieving standing instruction data within a financial software system. It provides method signatures for fetching templates, all instructions, individual instructions by ID, and loan dues data.

classes.name: StandingInstructionReadPlatformService
classes.description: Interface for reading or retrieving standing instruction related data within the account portfolio.

methods.name: retrieveTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a template of standing instruction data based on source and target account details.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Retrieves all standing instructions that match the given criteria.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific standing instruction by its unique ID.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Retrieves all standing instructions filtered by status.

methods.name: retriveLoanDuesData
methods.description: Retrieves dues data for a specific loan by its ID.
